summary: BioNTech SE filed a routine Form 6-K on November 3, 2026, furnishing its third quarter 2026 financial results and corporate update via press release (Exhibit 99.1) and conference-call presentation (Exhibit 99.2). Reported Q3 2026 revenues of EUR 1,289.2 million, IFRS net profit of EUR 184.5 million (adjusted EUR 440.9 million), and cash plus security investments of EUR 16.2 billion; full-year 2026 revenue guidance midpoint was raised to a EUR 1.7-1.9 billion range. No transactional event, no board recommendation, and no deal mechanics are disclosed; this is an ordinary earnings report, not a special situation.
